label: Gmail: On New Email
description: Fires once per new Gmail message matching a search query (e.g. 'label:inbox -from:me', 'has:attachment invoice'), carrying the decomposed message with attachments. Starts from the mailbox as it is at activation; older mail never replays. Each poll reads up to 500 messages, so a burst larger than that within one interval fires only its newest 500. The body is cut at `maxBodyChars` (50,000 by default), and shorter if it would still weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries; `bodyTruncated` says when.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Search query
inputs.description: Gmail search query. Empty = every new message.

inputs.name: maxBodyChars
inputs.label: Max body characters
inputs.description: The most characters of the body to keep; the rest is cut off and `bodyTruncated` is true. Whatever you set, the body is also cut to fit the 100 KB a wire carries.

outputs.name: bodyTruncated
outputs.description: True when the body was longer than `maxBodyChars` or than a wire carries, so `body` holds only its start (an HTML body cut there is no longer whole HTML).
